title: Uniflow - params.input_csv schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input_csv

sample_name.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and can only contain letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens. Example: 'Sample-1'

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fastq.gz'

library_type.errorMessage: Library type must be either 'DNA' or 'RNA'

demultiplexing_indices.errorMessage: Demultiplexing indices must be semicolon-separated strings containing only alphanumeric characters. Example: 'A1;A2;A3'

force_cells.errorMessage: Force cells must be a positive integer. Example: 5000
